description: This file implements the GeminiEmbedder class, which wraps the OpenAICompatibleEmbedder to provide embedding functionality using Google's Gemini API. It includes methods for creating embeddings, validating configuration, and providing embedder info.

classes.name: GeminiEmbedder
classes.description: A class that provides embedding capabilities via Google's Gemini API, wrapping an OpenAI-compatible embedder.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the GeminiEmbedder with API key and optional model ID, setting up the underlying OpenAICompatibleEmbedder.

methods.name: createEmbeddings
methods.description: Creates embeddings for given texts using Gemini's API, with error handling and telemetry logging.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the embedder configuration by delegating to the underlying embedder, with error handling and telemetry.

methods.name: embedderInfo
methods.description: Returns information about this embedder, specifically its name.
